newsitem.title: USA: Swisher stake lifted by Zweig-DiMenna.
newsitem.headline: Swisher stake lifted by Zweig-DiMenna.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Associates LLC said Monday it raised its stake in Swisher International Group Inc to 590,900 Class A common shares or 9.8 percent from 7.5 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 142,800 Class A common shares between February 11 and February 20 at prices ranging from $13.3844 to $14 per share.
Swisher, based in Charlotte, NC. provides hygiene services and products to U.S. businesses, primarily through franchises.
